```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(brandkit)
library(ggplot2)
brand_quarto_setup()  # or brand_quarto_setup("dark") for dark docs
```

## Overview

This document inherits all styling from `_brand.yml` automatically.
Quarto handles the document theme; brandkit handles ggplot2 plots.

## Scatter Plot

```{r}
#| label: scatter
#| fig-cap: "Auto-themed — no theme_brand() needed"
ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Iris Measurements")
```

## Sequential Palette

```{r}
#| label: heatmap
#| fig-cap: "Warm sequential palette from brand colours"
ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_brand_c(type = "warm") +
  labs(title = "Old Faithful Eruptions")
```

## Brand Colours

```{r}
#| label: colours
str(brand_colors())
```
